input: Research remote island campsites for summer

gold.taskTitle: Research Remote Island Campsites for Summer
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify suitable remote island camping locations for a summer trip.

questions.title: Which country or region should the island be in?
questions.description: Determine the geographic region or country the user wants to camp in.

questions.title: How many people will be on this trip?
questions.description: Clarify the group size to filter campsites by capacity.

questions.title: What specific months in summer are you targeting?
questions.description: Identify the exact travel window to check availability and weather conditions.

questions.title: How do you define remote: no facilities, no roads, no crowds?
questions.description: Clarify what remote means to the user so results match their expectations.

questions.title: What is your budget range for the entire trip?
questions.description: Understand budget constraints to filter sites by cost of access, permits, and gear.

questions.title: How will you get to the island: kayak, ferry, private boat?
questions.description: Determine the mode of transport to filter islands that are realistically accessible.

questions.title: Do you need any specific amenities like fresh water or toilets?
questions.description: Identify must-have on-site features so only compatible campsites are shortlisted.
